decisions.title: Dedicated catalog pipeline delivery boundary
decisions.decision: One public repository and dedicated organization Project; pipeline owns shared ingestion/review/publication, research owns policy/evidence and consumers own UI/service acceptance.
decisions.authority_and_limits: User mission; actual GitHub setup readback still required.

options.option: Dedicated shared pipeline
options.tradeoffs: One delivery boundary for reusable ETL/review/publication; requires separate maintenance and handoff ownership.

options.option: Keep machinery inside one consumer
options.tradeoffs: Lower repository count but couples other clients and broad research to one app release cycle.

consequences: Research and client ownership remain unchanged; new service deployment is not implied.

decisions.title: Preserve canonical research and frozen contracts
decisions.decision: Do not modify frozen builder v1 or reopen completed research criteria; route new semantics through research #40.
decisions.authority_and_limits: Existing research contract process, not new pipeline authority.
decisions.responsible_decision_role: Canonical research contract reviewer with affected consumers

options.option: Preserve frozen v1 and version extensions separately
options.tradeoffs: Retains consumer compatibility and original hashes; new semantics need an explicit adoption packet.

options.option: Mutate existing v1 in place
options.tradeoffs: Would change accepted wire meaning and break reproducibility; excluded by existing governance.

consequences: Broad catalog data may be withheld from builder projections until an accepted compatible mapping exists.

decisions.title: Deny missing or insufficient source-use permission
decisions.decision: Retrieval/display/cache/export/redistribution are separate and scoped per source, field, product and use; current GPUs.io API/display/export exclusion remains.
decisions.authority_and_limits: Source owner and research #60/#41 decisions are required for new uses.
decisions.responsible_decision_role: Canonical source-rights decision maker with research #41/#60 authority

options.option: Evaluate explicit material/product/use decisions
options.tradeoffs: Supports traceable grants and denials; requires field-level provenance and ongoing terms review.

options.option: Infer permission from public availability or a permissive fragment
options.tradeoffs: Reduces manual review but cannot establish eligible reuse; excluded by the accepted handoff.

consequences: Unknown, expired, revoked and excluded uses remain blocked even if schema validation succeeds.

decisions.title: Keep one canonical planner API
decisions.decision: Retain the accepted TypeScript/Node API and PostgreSQL on Render with website services/planner-api source placement; pipeline delivers exact approved bytes and handoff receipts, not a competing backend.
decisions.authority_and_limits: Existing service owner/coordinator; unfilled operating gates are not auto-assigned.
decisions.responsible_decision_role: Existing shared-service owner/coordinator and affected consumer reviewers

options.option: Feed the selected canonical planner API
options.tradeoffs: Reuses accepted authority and transaction model; requires exact byte and activation handoffs.

options.option: Create a separate planner API in this repository
options.tradeoffs: Duplicates build/auth/evaluation ownership and compatibility state; excluded from current scope.

consequences: Pipeline staging and workers must remain distinct from the canonical consumer service authority.

decisions.title: Synthetic-only repository bootstrap
decisions.decision: Initial fixtures are fictional and labeled; bootstrap performs no acquisition, paid provisioning or production deployment.
decisions.authority_and_limits: User mission and repository bootstrap gate.

options.option: Use labeled fictional fixtures only
options.tradeoffs: Enables repeatable validation without implying permissions; cannot establish real source capability.

options.option: Import existing research proposals as live seed data
options.tradeoffs: Could appear more realistic but lacks blanket publication clearance; excluded from bootstrap.

consequences: Synthetic grants, reviews and prices cannot satisfy a production release gate.

decisions.title: Native hierarchy with checklist execution detail
decisions.decision: Use Program > Epic > Work Package native issues, stable checklist Tasks/Subtasks, and promote tasks when an independent owner/review boundary is accepted.
decisions.authority_and_limits: Follows inspected leaderboard convention; actual native readback required.
decisions.responsible_decision_role: Pipeline maintainer and organization Project administrator

options.option: Native Program/Epic/WP with checklist tasks
options.tradeoffs: Matches established planning precedent and keeps independent outcomes navigable; later task promotion needs reconciliation.

options.option: Make every step a native issue
options.tradeoffs: Creates more independently assignable records but adds coordination overhead and duplicates checklist progress.

consequences: Stable task IDs survive promotion; native hierarchy and blockers are verified independently.

decisions.title: Real ownership and independent review
decisions.decision: Live native GitHub Assignees express accepted ownership; team-based access and independent approval follow organization policy.
decisions.authority_and_limits: No task assignee, on-call role or team member is invented.
decisions.responsible_decision_role: Authorized organization administrator and independent review coordinator

options.option: Use native Assignees and verified team permissions
options.tradeoffs: Preserves actual accepted ownership and least privilege; vacancies remain visible.

options.option: Infer ownership from historical roles or an Owner field
options.tradeoffs: Looks complete but invents assignments and creates conflicting authority; excluded.

consequences: Unfilled owner or independent-review roles can block readiness while useful local work continues.

decisions.title: Multi-domain pipeline schema separated from builder v1
decisions.decision: Use an independently versioned envelope and typed graph for models, offers, hardware, datasets, apps, papers, tools, use cases and guides; project only compatible subsets.
decisions.authority_and_limits: Research contract and affected receiving-owner review at implementation.
decisions.responsible_decision_role: Research taxonomy/contract reviewer and pipeline schema maintainer

options.option: Separate typed pipeline envelope with reviewed projections
options.tradeoffs: Supports diverse resource kinds; requires mapping/version governance.

options.option: Force all resources into frozen builder component kinds
options.tradeoffs: Reduces schemas but loses domain meaning and silently extends accepted v1; excluded.

consequences: Entity types remain extensible through accepted versions; unsupported projections are withheld.

decisions.title: First eligible source and pilot selection
decisions.decision: Select one model/provider and one hardware/runtime or tool pilot only after exact source-use scope and required fields are accepted.
decisions.authority_and_limits: No complete current research catalog/pricebook is presumed cleared.
decisions.responsible_decision_role: Relevant domain owner, source-rights decision maker and website receiving owner

options.option: Choose existing rights-eligible structured metadata
options.tradeoffs: Offers a bounded reproducible pilot with explicit field restrictions; may omit desired prices or capabilities.

options.option: Request a new source/use decision before selecting the pilot
options.tradeoffs: Can expand coverage but delays live intake until accepted evidence exists.

consequences: No complete existing research catalog or pricebook is presumed cleared; two distinct domain pilots are still required.

decisions.title: Pipeline worker runtime and durable execution placement
decisions.decision: Select only pipeline-owned runtime, scheduling and staging choices; preserve accepted canonical server/storage authority and justify any new large-object store.
decisions.authority_and_limits: Requires actual workload, owner, cost and recovery evidence before deployment.
decisions.responsible_decision_role: Pipeline technical maintainer with shared-service coordinator and operating owner

options.option: Small durable worker/staging layer integrated with accepted service
options.tradeoffs: Limits duplicated infrastructure; capacity must be measured.

options.option: Add independent queue/object-store services after measured need
options.tradeoffs: Can improve scale and isolation but adds cost, custody and restore complexity.

consequences: No new paid resource or object store is created by naming an architecture; deployment needs accepted custody and budgets.

decisions.title: Signing and release custody
decisions.decision: Define signer identity, key custody, rotation and recovery before any production-signed artifact; no real keys belong in bootstrap.
decisions.authority_and_limits: Accepted release owner and independent reviewer required.
decisions.responsible_decision_role: Release custodian and independent security reviewer

options.option: Short-lived workload signing identity
options.tradeoffs: Reduces static-key custody but needs a supported verification and identity policy.

options.option: Managed signing key with explicit custody and rotation
options.tradeoffs: Can fit existing infrastructure but requires recovery, access and compromise procedures.

consequences: No production signing or acceptance claim until selected identity, verification and recovery are proven.

decisions.title: Current pointer and public mirror compatibility
decisions.decision: Frozen /v1 reads remain bearer-authenticated; current/latest aliases and anonymous public mirrors need separately accepted contracts and rights decisions.
decisions.authority_and_limits: Research #40 and existing website #15–#18 consumer authority.
decisions.responsible_decision_role: Research #40 contract reviewer and website/service receiving owner

options.option: Use accepted authenticated v1 reads plus separately approved artifact channel
options.tradeoffs: Preserves frozen behavior and allows a narrow eligible public mirror with explicit rights.

options.option: Adopt a new version for anonymous discovery/current aliases
options.tradeoffs: Provides new semantics but needs coordinated schema, auth and consumer adoption.

consequences: A static public file is not an implementation of the globally bearer-authenticated frozen API.

decisions.title: Freshness distinguishes historical and current-state facts
decisions.decision: No universal TTL; capture/check/effective/publication times stay distinct, and a new snapshot alone does not invalidate saved builds.

options.option: Separate immutable historical facts from current-state checks
options.tradeoffs: Preserves reproducibility; volatile facts still require source-aware refresh.

options.option: Apply one global TTL to all facts
options.tradeoffs: Simplifies scheduling but invents expiry semantics and can invalidate valid pinned builds; excluded.

consequences: Capture/check/effective/publish timestamps and source-specific freshness status remain distinct.

decisions.title: Optional enrichment is proposal-only
decisions.decision: Any AI enrichment needs separate provider privacy/rights/cost acceptance; it cannot approve rights, create facts or execute source instructions.
decisions.authority_and_limits: No paid inference use is authorized by bootstrap.
decisions.responsible_decision_role: Pipeline maintainer, privacy/source-rights reviewers and cost authority

options.option: Use deterministic enrichment and human review first
options.tradeoffs: Avoids provider disclosure/cost and makes transformations reproducible; some editorial work remains manual.

options.option: Add bounded AI proposals after explicit approval
options.tradeoffs: May reduce review effort but introduces model provenance, privacy, hallucination and cost risks.

consequences: Generated content never approves rights, becomes independently verified evidence, or executes source instructions.

decisions.title: Production operational acceptance
decisions.decision: Identify actual operating owner, recovery custodian, budgets and service objectives; local tests do not establish a live supported service.
decisions.authority_and_limits: Preserve existing unfilled service operating gates; do not assign volunteers by assumption.
decisions.responsible_decision_role: Accepted operating owner, recovery custodian and independent release reviewer

options.option: Release only after actual operational acceptance
options.tradeoffs: Establishes custody, recovery and supported limits; can delay launch.

options.option: Keep service in synthetic/staging qualification
options.tradeoffs: Allows independent testing while roles or budgets are missing; cannot be described as supported production.

consequences: No person is assigned on-call responsibility by a role label or inherited client ownership.

decisions.title: Expansion after two bounded pilots
decisions.decision: Onboard datasets/apps/papers and other domains with their owning research corpus, rights assessment, measured maintenance cost and consumer acceptance.
decisions.authority_and_limits: Pending future accepted pilot evidence; no new research repository assumed created.
decisions.responsible_decision_role: Pipeline maintainer with each domain research owner and consumer reviewer

options.option: Expand after two qualified pilots using measured gates
options.tradeoffs: Tests reuse across distinct domains and bounds maintenance load; growth is deliberate.

options.option: Import all candidate domains immediately
options.tradeoffs: Increases apparent breadth but lacks rights, review capacity and accepted mappings; excluded from initial release.

consequences: Coverage reports preserve explicit unknown denominators and do not claim completeness of all AI.
